reason: The README clearly describes a DSH plugin for delegating tasks to subagents with per-call model and provider routing, making orchestration its primary user-facing purpose.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注册 subagent_model 工具，让模型在委派任务时按调用选择子代理的 provider、模型和输出令牌上限。
summaries.en: Adds a DeepSeek Harness subagent_model tool that lets each delegated call select the subagent provider, model, and output token limit.

capabilities: Selects the provider, model, and token limit per call
Supports background and continuable subagent sessions
Applies subagent tool filtering and delegation depth limits
